name: Next.js (static export)
description: Next.js is a React framework that, with output set to export, prerenders App Router pages to static HTML at build time.
notes: firstRelease from npm next 1.0.0 (2016-10-25). Markdown is not built in: this setup parses it with gray-matter and marked inside a Server Component. Built with output: 'export' and trailingSlash.
